title: Container Bookings: spot or contract rating by tier
content:
## Scope
This comparison covers the Container Bookings product line and shows, tier by tier, whether a booking may or must reference a service contract, and the lowest service contract tier rank that may carry the booking.

## What each setting means
- **Contract required**: the tier may only be booked under a service contract.
- **Contract reference allowed**: a booking of the tier may reference a service contract at all.
- **Minimum contract tier rank**: the lowest service contract tier rank that may carry the tier; 0 when no contract is needed.

## Tier table
| Tier | Contract reference at entry | Contract required | Contract reference allowed | Minimum contract tier rank |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | forbidden | no | no | 0 |
| AHL Spot Flex | forbidden | no | no | 0 |
| AHL Contract Booking | required | yes | yes | 1 |
| AHL Contract Priority | required | yes | yes | 4 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | optional | no | yes | 0 |
| AHL Premium Express | optional | no | yes | 0 |

The entry gates of AHL Contract Booking and AHL Contract Priority also name an active service contract as part of entry.

## Points of judgement
**May an AHL Spot Flex booking quote the customer's service contract?** No. Its contract reference is forbidden at entry and not allowed; the booking is spot-rated.

**Is a contract ever optional?** Yes: AHL Guaranteed Loading and AHL Premium Express allow a reference without requiring one, and their minimum rank is 0.

**Which tier asks for the highest contract rank?** AHL Contract Priority, with a minimum of rank 4, against rank 1 for AHL Contract Booking.
